answer_1.quote: Our primary goal of this work is to improve the safety of LLMs in multi-turn dialogues through proactive vulnerability discovery.
answer_1.outputs: multi-turn dialogue responses, attack prompts, safety-aligned rewrites

answer_2.quote: We adopt Attack Success Rate (ASR) as our primary evaluation metric, which is defined as the proportion of harmful responses generated in response to harmful queries.

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4o as an automatic judge to rigorously score responses on a 1-10 scale during evaluation.
methods: safety evaluator prompt with scoring criteria

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation study. Three trained annotators independently assessed 500 randomly sampled model responses, explicitly labeling unsafe samples as positive cases.
answer_4.guideline: explicitly labeling unsafe samples as positive cases
